title: UK to recognise Palestinian state despite pressure from US and families of hostages
summary: Keir Starmer expected to confirm move after concluding situation has deteriorated since he urged Israel to change course The UK is set to recognise a Palestinian state on Sunday despite pressure from the US and the families of hostages held by Hamas. Keir Starmer is expected to confirm the move after concluding the situation has deteriorated since he urged Israel to change course over the summer. Continue reading...

title: Power, politics and performance: Russia’s revamped Intervision song contest names a winner
